task.description:
Rework src/design/tenant-lifecycle-controls.md to address validator issue CDV-TM-04-05-SEC-001. Add explicit user-input validation rules for lifecycle endpoint inputs:

- tenant slug path parameter validation (allowed charset, length bounds, canonicalization rules, reject behavior)
- request body/action input validation (allowed values, required fields, type constraints, duplicate/redundant action handling)
- explicit error mapping for invalid input (e.g., 400/422 with deterministic error codes)

Keep design Type E; do not implement code. Once updated, set next_action to rerun CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR.
acceptance_criteria: Design explicitly defines input validation for all lifecycle inputs
Invalid-input behavior is specified with error mapping

result.summary: Reworked Type E design for tenant lifecycle controls with explicit input validation rules and deterministic invalid-input error mapping for TM-04/TM-05.
